title: Cross-functional work still needs a directly responsible person
text: Block’s proposed architecture includes individuals accountable for particular customer outcomes who can draw resources from several capabilities, alongside specialists and player-coaches. The useful design question is how outcome responsibility and resource authority are joined after information-routing work changes.
qualification: Corporate proposal, not evidence that removing management layers has already improved performance.
